title: Conditioned Activation Transport for T2I Safety Steering
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework and a benchmark dataset (SafeSteerDataset) focused on safety steering in Text-to-Image models. Its evaluation taxonomy specifically includes ethical and social categories such as Hate (Racism, Hate symbols, Stereotyping), Humiliation (Bullying), and Violence, which are used to measure the model's safety and adherence to ethical norms.
